q: What did King David tell Zadok, Nathan, and Benaiah to do for his son Solomon?
a: King David told his three loyal subjects to take Solomon to Gihon on David’s own mule and to anoint him as king over Israel.

q: What did Adonijah request from Bathsheba?
a: Adonijah requested that she ask Solomon for Abishag the Shunammite to be given to him as his wife.

q: Why did Bathsheba go to Solomon?
a: Bathsheba went to Solomon to ask that Abishag would be given to Adonijah as his wife.

q: What did Solomon build for his wife, Pharaoh’s daughter?
a: Solomon built a house like his own for Pharaoh’s daughter, his wife.

q: What did Solomon ask Yahweh to do for the righteous person?
a: Solomon asked that the righteous would be declared innocent and rewarded according to his righteousness.

q: Whom did Pharaoh give as a wife to Hadad?
a: Pharaoh gave to Hadad the sister of Queen Tahpenes as his wife.

q: What did Jeroboam ask his wife to do?
a: Jeroboam asked his wife to disguise herself and go to the prophet Ahijah in Shiloh.

q: Why did Jeroboam ask his wife to go to the prophet Ahijah?
a: Jeroboam asked his wife to go to the prophet Ahijah to find out what would happen to his sick son.

q: What did Ahijah say to the wife of Jeroboam?
a: When Ahijah heard her come in at the door he said to her, “I know you are Jeroboam’s wife, so do not pretend that you are someone else.”

q: How sick was the woman’s son?
a: The son’s sickness was so severe that there was no more breath left in him.

q: What did Yahweh tell Elijah to do?
a: Yahweh told Elijah to return to the wilderness near Damascus to anoint Hazael to be king over Aram, Jehu to be king over Israel, and Elisha to be a prophet in his place.
